Name: Lnh's Small Summit Farm
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。
Accept the commission of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/size][/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=5]小山顶农场 (Small Summit Farm)[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#00ff00]这是一个坐落在山顶的农场，云雾缭绕，没有城市的喧嚣，只有大自然的声音。[/color]
[color=#00ff00]This is a farm located on the mountaintop, far from the bustling city, with the sound of nature accompanying you.[/color]

[color=#00ffff]法师塔可以在config文件中禁用。
Wizard Tower can be disabled in the config file.
所有的图块都可以种植作物。
All tiles can be planted with crops.
默认替换标准农场，可以在config文件中更改农场类型。
Replace the standard farm by default, and you can change the farm type in the config file.[/color]

[/size][color=#ff00ff][size=4]如果你喜欢它，可以点个赞吗？非常感谢
